' FROM Albums ORDER BY LastUpdateTime DESC' ); foreach ($results as $row) { if ($row['MarketingBudget'] == null) { $row['MarketingBudget'] = 'NULL'; } if ($row['LastUpdateTime'] == null) { $row['LastUpdateTime'] = 'NULL'; } printf('SingerId: %s, AlbumId: %s, MarketingBudget: %s, LastUpdateTime: %s' .
